narr: Thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in southeastern Pennsylvania during the afternoon and early evening of July 2.
ev: Widespread roadway flooding in North Philadelphia in the vicinity of North Broad Street from West Erie Avenue to West Allegheny Avenue.
lsr: FLOODING REPORTED ON BROAD ST NEAR RISING SUN AVE. DISPATCHERS REPORTED SEVERAL FLOODING RELATED CALLS IN THIS SECTION OF PHILADELPHIA.
